channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: 'The People's Open': Meeting fans and celebs at WM Phoenix Open
item.description: Matt Ginella takes a tour of TPC Scottsdale ahead of the 2026 WM Phoenix Open to catch up with fans and pro-am celebs, to see what makes "The People's Open" so special.

item.title: Patrick Reed closes in on second DP World Tour title in three starts
item.description: Patrick Reed kept a clean card Saturday for a 2-under 70 in the Qatar Masters, a round that slightly expanded his lead and greatly expanded his confidence.

item.title: Back in control: Scottie Scheffler believes 'special round' can lead to third WM Phoenix Open title
item.description: Scottie Scheffler might not have the lead entering Sunday but believes in his chances to climb back and win his third WM Phoenix Open.

item.title: WM Phoenix Open: Final Round tee times, groupings, how to watch
item.description: The People's Open concludes in the Arizona desert on Sunday where a pair of Americans, Akshay Bhatia and Chris Gotterup, look to break through and pull an upset.

item.title: Matsuyama shoots 68 to take 1-shot lead at WM Phoenix Open with top-ranked Scheffler lurking
item.description: The two-time WM Phoenix Open champion was tied with Ryo Hisatsune after 17 holes, but took the outright lead into the final round after his countryman failed to get up-and-down from the greenside bunker for a bogey on 18.

item.title: McNealy: TPC Scottsdale ramps up the adrenaline
item.description: Maverick McNealy shot 65 Saturday in the 2026 WM Phoenix Open to get within one shot of the the 54-hole lead. He chats with Ryan Lavner about how TPC Scottsdale really gets the juices flowing.

item.title: Si Woo Kim swinging it the best he ever has – and trying to 'hit the chunk'
item.description: Kim is T-2 through 54 holes of the WM Phoenix Open as he's gained nearly eight shots on approach the last two days at TPC Scottsdale.

item.title: Scheffler looking for 'special round' to win third WM Phoenix Open
item.description: Scottie Scheffler is five strokes back entering the final round of the 2026 WM Phoenix Open. He said it'll take a "special round" to win for a third time at TPC Scottsdale, but he knows it's possible.

item.title: Moving Day: McNealy in position for second Tour win
item.description: Maverick McNealy put himself in contention for his second career PGA Tour win, shooting 65 on Moving Day to get within one of the 54-hole lead at the WM Phoenix Open.

item.title: PGA Tour Highlights 2026: WM Phoenix Open, Round 3
item.description: Hideki Matsyuma opened up his third round at TPC Scottsdale with three out of four birdies. A pair of bogeys prevented him from gaining separation from fellow countryman Ryo Hisatsune. Si Woo Kim nailed an eagle on the 3rd hole but struggled with bogeys as well. Elsewhere, Akshay Bhatia also had an up-and-down afternoon with seven birdies and three bogeys. Nicolai Højgaard and Jake Knapp were bogey-free, setting themselves up for a chance to win on Sunday.
